Riley: Quick experiment — swap one single track and one short book that's perfect for a 30–90 minute sink-in. No long sagas. I'll start: 
Riley: Track — "St. Vincent - New York" (3:30). Book — 'The Mezzanine' by Nicholson Baker (tiny and weird). :books::headphones:
Priya: Love that combo. My pick: 
Priya: Track — 'Arthur Russell - A Little Lost' (knees weak). Book — 'The Sense of an Ending' (compact, quiet). :sparkles:
Marco: Ooh. Throwing in something moodier: 
Marco: Track — 'Billie Holiday - Strange Fruit' (intense but short). Book — 'The Great Gatsby' (cheat classic, under 200 pages).
Libby: For a ridiculous mood lift: 
Libby: Track — 'MGMT - Time to Pretend' (classic pump-up). Book — 'The Emperor's Soul' by Brandon Sanderson (bite-sized fantasy novelette). :fire:
Nora: My night shelf picks: 
Nora: Track — 'Julia Holter - Mariners Apartment Complex' (dreamy). Book — 'Shop Class as Soulcraft' (short essays, weirdly soothing).
Riley: Nice spread. Anyone got a straight playlist link? I'm lazy. :coffee:
Priya: Here's a tiny collaborative playlist I made (adds are welcome): https://open.spotify.com/playlist/0exampleFakeLink (replace with your own)
Marco: Also, for anyone who wants a mini reading list, I keep PDFs of public domain short stories here: ```/shared/team/shorts/``` — drop a note if you want upload access.
Libby: Poll time — vote with emoji: :one: for 'mood elevator' (Libby/Priya), :two: for 'quiet/meditative' (Riley/Nora), :three: for 'classic punch' (Marco). I'll tally in an hour. :ballot_box_with_check:
ops-bot: Reminder: office bookshelf purge this Friday at 4pm — anything unclaimed goes to the free shelf by reception. Good time to drop swaps in person! :package:
Priya: Results so far: :one: 3 :two: 5 :three: 1 — quiet wins. Guess we'll do a chilled listening hour during Friday's sync coffee. :tea:
Riley: Love that. Bring any physical books you want to swap and maybe a USB stick of odd tracks for the communal playlist. :handshake:
